source: OpenAlex works citing each contested paper, publication_year 2020-2026, pulled 2026-10-01 in the browser (no key stored here); EGU discussion comments/replies and duplicate titles removed; stance assigned by reading title, venue and abstract (not the citing context).

classes.S: advances or builds on the contested claim (includes the minority programme's own papers)
classes.R: tests the claim and reports against it, or cites it as the position argued against
classes.H: neutral: background, mechanism taken up without the claim, methodological or historical mention

svensmark1997.note: counts for S, H and X estimated from titles and venues; the S class here includes regional sunspot/cosmic-ray correlation studies as well as the minority programme

R_titles: Erroneous use of Statistics behind Claims of a Major Solar Role in Recent Warming (RAA 2022)
A Discussion of Implausible Total Solar-Irradiance Variations Since 1700 (Solar Physics 2024)
Is there a link between the length of the solar cycle and Earth's temperature? (Rendiconti Lincei 2022)
fcl1991.note: counts estimated from titles and venues

cross_citation.note: first-author counts over the 581 citing entries (a work citing k contested papers counts k times)

revisions.note: After reading the Semantic Scholar citation sentences: Spencer & Christy 1990 — W4248376655, W4281489977, W4315645665 (Koutsoyiannis et al.) moved S→H, the citation being to the UAH dataset's source paper, not to the 1990 trend claim; Lewis & Curry 2018 — W4386805034 (Spencer & Christy 2023, 1D-model effective sensitivity) moved H→S. Also moved R→H on the same reading: Lewis & Curry 2018 — W4292327149 (lists it among pattern-effect studies); Spencer & Christy 1990 — W4311474670 (cites it for the MSU record).

After reading the citing papers' full texts for 22 of the 39 S-class entries without an indexed sentence: Lewis & Curry 2018 — W4385429326 (Critical Review on Radiative Forcing…, Atmosphere 2023) moved from S to H (cites the paper for the width of the ECS range, not its level). All other entries read (21) confirmed S. See data/citer-sentences.json, full_text_pass_2026_10_03.
